beats.narration: You are looking for one name in a phone book with a million entries. Reading every page would work. There is a much faster way, and it only needs one idea.
Open the book in the middle. If the name you want comes earlier in the alphabet, the whole back half is useless. Throw it away and repeat on what is left.

params.heading: The one idea
items: Discard the half that cannot hold it
Repeat on the half that remains

beats.narration: Each comparison cuts the search space in half. A million entries becomes half a million, then a quarter million. After about twenty steps there is only one entry left.
The catch is that the data must already be sorted. Without order, the middle tells you nothing about where the target is.

params.title: Sorted data is the price
params.subtitle: Order is what lets you throw half away
